Description:
Something cute I did for myself that I decided to share!


[b]How to put in your game: [/b]
[i]Extract the baby brown chicken and brown chicken xnbs to your Stardew Valley/Content/Animals folder.

Extract the spring objects xnb to your Stardew Valley/Content/Maps folder

Extract the ObjectInformation xnb to your Stardew Valley/Content/Data folder

Extract the cursors xnb to your Stardew Valley/Content/LooseSprites folder
